title: Changing the lead leaves the work order's scheduled time unchanged
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order with recorded time, an active clock-in, and a scheduled shift.
custom_steps:
1. Make a Schedule change on the work order and confirm the lead technician does not change.
  2. Change the lead of the work order and confirm the status is unchanged.
  3. Confirm active, recorded, and locked time are unchanged by the lead change and any shift clearing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Making a Schedule change does not change the work order's lead technician.
  • A lead change leaves the work order's status unchanged.
  • A lead change and any optional shift clearing leave active, recorded, and locked time unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S4-R19, S4-R20, S4-R21 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R19: “Moving, resizing, or reassigning a shift on the Schedule does not change the work order’s lead technician. This is how the Schedule behaves today, and it stays that way.”
  • S4-R20: “A lead change leaves work order status unchanged.”
  • S4-R21: “Lead changes and optional shift clearing leave active, recorded, and locked time unchanged.”
